name: Paint
description: Paint on layers over a picture, or on a blank canvas: you get the picture with the paint on it and the mask you painted.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: The picture to paint over. Unset: a blank canvas of the Width and Height.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Width
inputs.description: A blank canvas's width. Unset: the picture's, else the painting's own.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.description: A blank canvas's height. Unset: the picture's, else the painting's own.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.label: Paint
inputs.description: The layers you painted, one file beside your pictures. Nothing painted gives the picture as it is and an empty mask.
